entities.name: Shikar
entities.description: Kingdom of Casindral in southern Corondor, a majestic trade city west of the Great Salt Marshes.

entities.name: Sulgh
entities.description: Swamp across the river from Shikar.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: Ruler of the Sulgh swamp who destroyed the trade path.

entities.name: Chondaeh
entities.description: Killed everyone in Khone but Gydolien Mor.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: Survivor of Khone who plotted revenge.

entities.name: Aldon
entities.description: Brought by his Serra Angel to see Shikar's Elvish Archers.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Conqueror of Shikar during the Planeswalker War.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: War during which Ravidel conquered Shikar.

entities.name: Embereck
entities.description: Defender convinced by Leshrac to fight Ravidel.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker who convinced Embereck to take on Ravidel.

entities.name: Elder Druid of Corondor
entities.description: Helped citizens escape and was killed by Ravidel.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who came to help Shikar.

events.summary: Sol'Kanar destroys the path to Khone, forcing both kingdoms to send tribute.
events.quote: When Sol'Kanar the Swamp King destroyed the path

events.summary: Ravidel conquers Shikar during the Planeswalker War; Eskil tries to defend it.
events.quote: Shikar was conquered by Ravidel during the Planeswalker War

events.summary: The Elder Druid of Corondor and Teferi arrive too late and only help citizens escape.
events.quote: the three could do little more than help the citizens of Shikar escape alive

relations.quote: became known as the Contrary Kingdoms
